//go:build kubeapiserver

// Copied into stackstate-agent pkg/collector/corechecks/cluster/kubeapi by
// generate.sh. It maps testdata/objects.json with the cluster agent's event
// mapper and OOM synthesis, applies what checkSender.Event and
// BufferedAggregator.addEvent do next, and records the body the serializer
// sends to the intake.
package kubeapi

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"

	logmock "github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/comp/core/log/mock"
	forwarder "github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/comp/forwarder/defaultforwarder"
	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/comp/forwarder/defaultforwarder/transaction"
	metricscompressionimpl "github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/comp/serializer/metricscompression/impl"
	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/collector/corechecks/cluster/urn"
	core "github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/collector/corechecks"
	configmock "github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/config/mock"
	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/metrics/event"
	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/serializer"
	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/tagset"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/mock"
	v1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
)

const (
	goldenClusterName      = "golden-cluster"
	goldenDefaultHost      = "agent-host"
	goldenInternalHostname = "collector-pod"
)

func TestGenerateEventsExporterGolden(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("GOLDEN_FIXTURE"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var objects []json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &objects); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	check := NewKubernetesAPIEventsCheck(core.NewCheckBase(KubernetesAPIEventsCheckName), &EventsConfig{})
	out := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
	for _, clusterType := range []urn.ClusterType{urn.Kubernetes, urn.OpenShift} {
		mapper := &kubernetesEventMapper{
			urn:                     urn.NewURNBuilder(clusterType, goldenClusterName),
			clusterName:             goldenClusterName,
			sourceType:              string(clusterType),
			eventCategoriesOverride: map[string]EventCategory{"MysteryChange": Changes},
		}
		var events []event.Event
		for _, object := range objects {
			var kind struct {
				Kind string `json:"kind"`
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(object, &kind); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			switch kind.Kind {
			case "Event":
				var ev v1.Event
				if err := json.Unmarshal(object, &ev); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				mapped, err := mapper.mapKubernetesEvent(&ev)
				if err != nil {
					continue
				}
				events = append(events, mapped)
			case "Pod":
				var pod v1.Pod
				if err := json.Unmarshal(object, &pod); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				events = append(events, check.podToEventMapper(&pod, mapper, nil)...)
			}
		}
		submitted := make(event.Events, 0, len(events))
		for i := range events {
			e := events[i]
			if e.Host == "" {
				e.Host = goldenDefaultHost
			}
			tb := tagset.NewHashlessTagsAccumulatorFromSlice(e.Tags)
			tb.SortUniq()
			e.Tags = tb.Get()
			submitted = append(submitted, &e)
		}
		out[string(clusterType)] = serializeEvents(t, submitted)
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("GOLDEN_OUTPUT"), append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func serializeEvents(t *testing.T, events event.Events) json.RawMessage {
	cfg := configmock.New(t)
	compressor := metricscompressionimpl.NewCompressorReq(metricscompressionimpl.Requires{Cfg: cfg}).Comp
	f := &forwarder.MockedForwarder{}
	var payloads transaction.BytesPayloads
	f.On("SubmitV1Intake", mock.Anything, mock.Anything).Run(func(args mock.Arguments) {
		payloads = append(payloads, args.Get(0).(transaction.BytesPayloads)...)
	}).Return(nil)
	s := serializer.NewSerializer(f, nil, compressor, cfg, logmock.New(t), goldenInternalHostname)
	if err := s.SendEvents(events); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(payloads) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one intake payload, got %d", len(payloads))
	}
	body, err := compressor.Decompress(payloads[0].GetContent())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !json.Valid(body) {
		t.Fatalf("serializer produced invalid JSON: %s", body)
	}
	return body
}
